turns.q: Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
turns.replyTail:
Thanks for reaching out to us. Yes, a damaged item is handled differently from a normal return. Normal change-of-mind returns and exchanges aren’t accepted, but a damaged item can be submitted as a warranty claim with picture proof.

If the claim qualifies, the resolution is a replacement or store credit. Refunds aren’t offered for damaged-item claims. Submit it here: https://evryjewels-claims.web.app/ 💖

turns.q: How long does the replacement take?
turns.replyTail:
Once an approved replacement ships, delivery typically takes:

2 to 7 business days for domestic orders
15 to 20 business days for international orders

This timing starts from the shipment date and does not include processing time. Weather, holidays, and customs clearance can add time, so these are estimates rather than guarantees 💖

turns.q: What if more than one item in my order is affected?
turns.replyTail:
Thanks for getting in touch. If more than one item is damaged, include every affected item and a clear photo of each one in the same claim.

The items must be resolved together, so we can’t replace some and issue store credit for others in the same claim. If any affected item is out of stock, the claim is handled with store credit for all affected items. If they’re all in stock, the available resolution depends on your order’s coverage and the option allowed for your claim 💖

turns.q: What if the replacement is also damaged?
turns.replyTail:
Thanks for getting in touch. If the replacement also arrives damaged, submit a new damaged-item claim with clear photos of the replacement and its replacement order number here: https://evryjewels-claims.web.app/

A second remedy is not automatic and will need to be reviewed. Refunds aren’t offered for damaged-item claims 💖
